# War Scroll Column 1 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 1 | **Condition:** complete

---

**1:1** For the Teacher — the rules governing the war. The first attack by the Children of Light will target the forces of the Children of Darkness: the army of Belial, including the forces of Edom, Moab, and Ammon,

**1:2** the army of the Philistine territories, and the forces of the Kittim of Asshur, along with those who have broken the covenant — partners in evil.

**1:3** The descendants of Levi, Judah, and Benjamin — those exiled in the wilderness — will fight against all these forces when the exiles among the Children of Light return from the Desert of the Nations

**1:4** to make camp in the Desert of Jerusalem. After that war, they will march up from there [...] against the Kittim of Egypt.

**1:5** At the appointed time, he will march out in fierce anger to make war on the northern kings. His fury will aim to destroy them and shatter their power

**1:6** completely. This will be the time of deliverance for God's people, a decisive moment of triumph for everyone on his side, and total, permanent ruin for everyone allied with Belial.

**1:7** Terror will seize the descendants of Japheth. Asshur will collapse with no one to rescue him. The empire of the Kittim will come to an end. Evil will be crushed

**1:8** completely, with no remnant left — not a single survivor among the Children of Darkness.

**1:9** Then the Children of Righteousness will shine across the whole earth, blazing brighter and brighter until every era of darkness has passed. In God's chosen moment, his supreme glory will blaze

**1:10** throughout all eternity — bringing peace, blessing, honor, joy, and endless life to all the Children of Light. On the day the Kittim fall, fierce and devastating battle will erupt

**1:11** before the God of Israel, for he long ago designated that day for the final war to annihilate the Children of Darkness. On that day, the heavenly assembly

**1:12** and the human congregation will clash together in massive destruction. The Children of Light and the forces of Darkness will battle with the full power of God,

**1:13** accompanied by the roar of a vast throng and the battle cries of angels and warriors on the day of catastrophe. It will be the worst crisis God's redeemed people have ever faced.

**1:14** Of all their sufferings, nothing will compare to this, from the first clash to final, eternal redemption. On the day they fight the Kittim, they will march out

**1:15** to battle. Three times the Children of Light will advance to crush evil, and three times Belial's army will rally to push back the forces of [...]

**1:16** The foot soldiers will spread terror, but God's own power will fortify the courage of the Children of Light. Then, in the decisive seventh engagement, God's mighty hand will overthrow

**1:17** Belial, along with every angel under his command, and all who belong to his side will be destroyed forever.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic equivalence rendering of 1QM Column 1. The column presents an overview of the eschatological war between good and evil. "Kittim" is retained as a proper noun (widely understood as a code name for Rome). The seven-round battle structure reflects the scroll's apocalyptic theology, where divine intervention in the final round determines ultimate victory.*
